Garage Job Detail invents capital as purchase minus 150000. Replace only that derivation with actual source or unavailable. VehicleDetailView.tsx:126 separately hard-codes Stock capital to zero; both require actual-contribution-or-unavailable mapping.
Neither demo has production auth, tenant isolation or financial transaction authority. JS numeric helpers must not become canonical money authority.
QuickActionModal always creates Stock / Investor with hard-coded 650000 purchase/totalCost despite Stock / Customer title; no Fund validation. Complete shared form without rebuilding listing pages.
React navigation includes only six report links from the 17-report directory. Add missing keys without renaming existing ones.
Garage filtering varies among source screens; Fund is Company-wide and capital recoveries are not allocated by Garage. Do not infer scope from selector presence.
Full Parts Inventory is outside canonical baseline while demos contain purchase/issue workflows. Retain observed demo UI contracts; production scope expansion needs a business decision.
React local state and main Data snapshot are separate schemas; no API bridge exists. Integration requires explicit mapping and authorization, not page rewrites.
Root README says no React frontend; map verification headers cite older snapshots. Treat these as stale documentation claims relative to current source.
Accent values and radii vary across accepted components; do not normalize by rewriting approved pages.
Route-map claims expense correction and pending build/reset checks not proven by current source. Later handoff claims are not current runtime verification.
